description: RFC 8785 canonicalization. Parse `input-json` (raw JSON text, so that member order, escapes and numeric literals are preserved exactly), canonicalize, and compare bytes against `canonical` and its SHA-256 against `canonical-sha256`.

vectors.name: empty-object
vectors.description: the empty object

vectors.name: empty-array
vectors.description: the empty array

vectors.name: empty-structures-nested
vectors.description: empty containers nest and sort

vectors.name: literals
vectors.description: the three JSON literals

vectors.name: key-order-basic
vectors.description: ASCII names sort by code unit, uppercase first

vectors.name: key-order-prefix
vectors.description: a shorter name that is a prefix sorts first

vectors.name: key-order-utf16-vs-codepoint
vectors.description: U+1F60A (UTF-16 D83D DE0A) MUST sort BEFORE U+FFE0; sorting by code point or by UTF-8 bytes puts it after, which is the classic RFC 8785 section 3.2.3 trap

vectors.name: key-order-nested
vectors.description: sorting applies at every level; array element order is never changed

vectors.name: array-order-preserved
vectors.description: arrays keep input order, objects inside do not

vectors.name: whitespace-insignificant
vectors.description: insignificant whitespace is removed

vectors.name: string-escape-decoded-names
vectors.description: escaped names are decoded before sorting

vectors.name: string-escapes-minimal
vectors.description: only the mandated short escapes are emitted

vectors.name: string-control-chars
vectors.description: C0 controls become lowercase \u00xx; U+0020 and U+007F are emitted literally

vectors.name: string-non-ascii-literal
vectors.description: non-ASCII, including U+2028/U+2029, is emitted literally as UTF-8 and never \u-escaped

vectors.name: no-unicode-normalization
vectors.description: NFC and NFD forms stay distinct names and distinct values; canonicalization never normalizes

vectors.name: number-integers
vectors.description: integral values

vectors.name: number-precision-loss
vectors.description: 9007199254740993 has no binary64 representation and serializes as ...992

vectors.name: number-exponent-boundaries
vectors.description: the five ECMAScript Number::toString branches, at their boundaries

vectors.name: number-extremes
vectors.description: binary64 extremes

vectors.name: number-fractions
vectors.description: fractional values use the shortest round-tripping digits

vectors.name: deep-nesting
vectors.description: recursion through mixed containers

vectors.name: envelope-shaped
vectors.description: a protocol-object-shaped input, for sanity

vectors.name: number-seventeen-significant-digits
vectors.description: one ULP apart under a fast float parser; the collision the review reproduced

vectors.name: number-twenty-one-integer-digits
vectors.description: an integer literal beyond binary64's exact range — the rounding must still be correct

vectors.name: number-subnormal-boundary
vectors.description: crosses normal/subnormal: 0x0010000000000000 vs 0x000fffffffffffff

vectors.name: number-negative-seventeen-digits
vectors.description: the same defect on the negative side, which no existing case covered
